limits: Independent only of OPUS byte-table instrument, same decoder family/tool is disclosed. Reachable flow starts at proposed entry and follows both conditional direct edges inside span; calls not traversed. External/indirect jumps bounded exits, not complete logical function/normalreachability proof. No computed-pointer recovery, byte-table rerun, semantic/admission/population ruling or PE root extent substitution. Numeric catalog spans can contain gaps and are not automatically native overlap proof.
